interaction: Shape a pot on a spinning wheel by dragging the belly, neck and lip handles (or using the height and width sliders and cup/bowl/vase/bottle presets); a per-pixel Canvas lathe shades the revolved clay, then pick one of four glazes and 'Fire it' for a kiln-glow firing to 1240°C that reveals the glossy, speckled glazed pot.
notes: The pot is rendered by a small software lathe (per-pixel shading of a monotone-spline profile) rather than WebGL. Class bookings and shop reserves are demo toasts; volume and firing curve are illustrative.
